answer: A4 (gateway / lazy-activation) is described here as a pipeline fixture, not as a live ADV dossier. One mediating entry indexes capabilities and materializes only what a task selects. Every class has a deactivation path. When the resident-set budget is exhausted the activator refuses an activation.
